question: Which coating material in Table 5 has the highest Li-ion diffusivity?
rendered: According to Table 5 in "Valuation of Surface Coatings in High-Energy Density Lithium-ion Battery Cathode Materials", the coating material with the highest Li-ion diffusivity is TiO2 (Anatase) with a value of 4.7 × 10^− 12 cm^2/s.
